note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Run production unattended on Arcadia's own repository
purpose: Arcadia should carry an Action from launch to a merged pull request on its own repository, with little operator attention. The worker launches a Claude session, keeps a reviewed pull request, merges it when it is not authority-adjacent, and moves to the next Action within a spend limit.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia driving coding agents and reporting back, asking the operator only when a decision is genuinely needed.
done_when: A multi-Action run on Arcadia's own repository reaches merged pull requests, and the only operator touches are activation and merges of authority-adjacent changes.

actions.title: Keep the real cause when a session fails to launch
actions.why: A launch failure logged without its cause cannot be fixed, as an earlier run that failed 155 times showed.
actions.done_when: Launch failures show the underlying error text in the red-alert evidence and in production status, bounded in length.

actions.title: Prove the worker can launch a Claude session
actions.why: The first supervised run needs evidence that the worker reaches a running session on the Claude provider.
actions.done_when: A replay of one launch on the Claude provider reaches a running session and a draft pull request, and each defect it finds has a regression test.

actions.title: Refresh Claude usage before admitting unattended runs
actions.why: Without a fresh usage reading, the capacity gate refuses Claude runs as stale, which stops unattended work.
actions.done_when: The worker refreshes the Claude usage reading before admission, or production status states the gate-off path and what it means for Claude runs.

actions.title: Run one supervised Action on the Arcadia repository
actions.why: No production run had yet completed an Action on a real repository, so this is the first proof on it.
actions.done_when: One Action runs with the operator activating once, reaches a draft pull request, gets an independent review and merges.

actions.title: Let the worker merge reviewed pull requests
actions.why: The worker could not merge, so every Action needed a supervisor. This removes that step.
actions.done_when: The worker merges only through the pull request, after an independent review of the exact head finds no blocking issue and required checks pass, and never merges authority-adjacent changes.

actions.title: Enforce the approved spend budget at admission
actions.why: Without a window budget, an unattended run could use up the operator's own allowance on shared accounts.
actions.done_when: A launch that would exceed the budget or reserve is refused and shown in production status, and an unreadable usage reading counts as unknown, not admitted.

actions.title: Check the provider login before launching
actions.why: An expired login would otherwise be found only after launch, stalling the run with no alert.
actions.done_when: A launch with an expired or unrefreshable provider login is refused, the remedy is named, and the operator is alerted once.

actions.title: Evidence a multi-Action unattended run
actions.why: This is the milestone's proof that Arcadia keeps momentum on its own repository without supervision.
actions.done_when: At least three ready Actions reach merged pull requests, and the only operator touches are activation and merges of authority-adjacent changes.

actions.title: Test that an over-budget admission names the budget and window
actions.why: Makes a refusal say which limit was hit, so the operator knows what to change.
actions.done_when: An admission over budget on the 5-hour or 7-day window is refused, and the refusal names the 80% unattended budget and that window.

actions.title: Test that a refused tmux launch leaves no launcher file
actions.why: A failed launch should not leave stray launch files behind to confuse later runs.
actions.done_when: When the tmux launch fails, the test finds no launcher file left behind.

actions.title: Test that a long brief reaches a session unchanged
actions.why: Confirms a 64 KiB brief is not altered on its way to an interactive session.
actions.done_when: A 64 KiB brief arrives at a stub provider byte for byte identical, and its temporary folder is removed afterwards.

actions.title: Write a report of the first supervised Claude run
actions.why: Records each stage, failure and fix, so the evidence for the run can be checked later.
actions.done_when: A report records every stage, each failure with its fixing item and the operator touches, and each cited number resolves on GitHub.

actions.title: Test that transient review errors still retry
actions.why: A reviewer's temporary error should not wrongly stop the review of a candidate.
actions.done_when: A transient reviewer error is retried on a later tick, and resetting the repair budget keeps the exhausted-attempts escalation in place.

actions.title: Correct two stale notes in the readiness record and a test fake
actions.why: Stale text makes the readiness record show a decision as still open after it was approved.
actions.done_when: The readiness record states that decision 0130 is approved, and the test fake no longer returns a refresh token it does not use.

actions.title: Stop a repair write from overwriting unrelated rows
actions.why: A shared request id could let the gate overwrite the summary of an unrelated repair row.
actions.done_when: The gate's write changes only rows of its own role, and a test with a different-role row shows that row is left as it was.

actions.title: Test that reused acknowledgment receipt ids are refused
actions.why: An existing test never reached the receipt-kind check, so that branch had no direct test.
actions.done_when: Reporting or disposing a message with an already-used acknowledgment receipt id is refused with the kind-mismatch error, and the message stays acknowledged.

actions.title: Stop a launch test from using the host's tmux server
actions.why: A leftover session on the host could make the test fail for a reason unrelated to its code.
actions.done_when: The test checks the session name through a stub and passes even when a host tmux session with that name exists.

actions.title: Retry a transient cleanup error in the guidance test
actions.why: A temporary busy-folder error was failing the whole test shard in continuous integration.
actions.done_when: The test's cleanup retries a temporary not-empty error, and no existing assertion is changed or skipped.

actions.title: Rebuild the mail receipt test from the current base
actions.why: A fresh rebuild lets the test be checked against current code without reusing evidence from a held change.
actions.done_when: The receipt-kind test exists on the current base and passes with fresh evidence, and every other test in the file is unchanged.

actions.title: Leave Codex config untouched when it is already correct
actions.why: Stops a needless rewrite of the config that could block a later adoption attempt.
actions.done_when: When the managed settings are already correct, the config file keeps its exact bytes and no backup is made, and genuinely different values are still corrected.
